item.title: Broadway Under the Stars - Mamma Mia! — Fri Aug 21, 7:00 PM — Sonoma Valley Field of Dreams
item.description:
The global smash hit is coming to Sonoma for the very first time! Set on a sun-drenched Greek island, Mamma Mia! follows a young bride-to-be on a quest to discover the identity of her father — bringing three very unexpected guests from her mother’s past back into their lives. Fueled by ABBA’s greatest hits (including “Dancing Queen,” “Mamma Mia,” “The Winner Takes It All,” and more), this joyful tale of family, friendship, love, and second chances has captured the hearts of millions worldwide. With its large cast, explosive dance numbers, nonstop humor, and irresistible score, Mamma Mia! promises to be one of the biggest and most unforgettable productions in Transcendence history. Mamma Mia! is presented through special arrangement with Music Theatre International (MTI). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: Matt Jaffe — Sat Aug 22, 4:00 PM — Waterhawk Lake Club
item.description:
Matt Jaffe is an indie rock & roll singer/songwriter from San Francisco. Cutting his teeth on countless open mics around the Bay, Matt started taking music \(a little bit\) more seriously when Jerry Harrison of Talking Heads offered to produce his first record. Since then, Matt has continued to churn out more songs than he can remember the words to, perform on stages throughout the land \(opening and/or touring with the likes of Mavis Staples, Wilco, Bob Weir, Jackie Greene, Chuck Prophet, Melissa Etheridge, and Blues Traveler\), and collaborate with Tom Higgenson of the Plain White T's. Inspired by the likes of Elvis Costello, Tom Petty and Stephin Merritt, Matt is continuously writing and recording to build a songbook that honors his heroes. Along with serving on Bread & Roses Board of Directors, he is currently rolling out his 7th studio album, Gone Enough to Miss.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:

Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.

Each plate comes with a thick slice of herbed focaccia and a refreshing side of Sunray Farm cucumber, mint, and dill tossed with citrus vinaigrette. This flavorful combination makes for a satisfying comfort-food experience with a fresh, seasonal twist. Available for dine-in or to-go, guests can enjoy this weekly Sunday special from the comfort of the restaurant or take it home for a delicious feast. item.title: SBC # 575 Sonoma Clean Power CEO, Geof Syphers – Getting to 100% Renewable Energy – 600 MW of new local geothermal power? — Mon Aug 24, 6:00 PM — Hopmonk Sebastopol
item.description:
Come for a fun electric science demo and Monday night meet Geof Syphers, CEO and leader of the Sonoma Clean Power mission – getting to 100% renewable energy. SCP is proposing to build up to 600 MW of new local geothermal power. How will they do that? Also, join us for a fun electric science demo featuring Nicola! SCP is partnering with Eavor and seeking additional partners to build advanced, low-water systems that can extract heat without needing to inject large amounts of wastewater into the ground, which also limits seismic risks. Residents and businesses in Sonoma and Mendocino counties can access this power by enrolling in SCP’s EverGreen premium service. EverGreen guarantees 100% renewable power day and night by combining local solar, batteries and geothermal.
Source: Sebastopol Calendar
